apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata: { name: pgdump }
spec:
  schedule: '{{schedule}}'
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
          containers:
            - name: dump
              image: postgres:16
              env:
                - { name: DSN, value: '{{dsn}}' }
              command: ['/bin/sh','-c']
              args:
                - >
                  pg_dump "$DSN" | gzip |
                  aws s3 cp - s3://{{s3_bucket}}/pg-$(date +%F-%H%M).sql.gz
summary_zh: k8s CronJob pg_dump 串流到 S3 並壓縮
